title: PDF/OMR Companion Tools
description: Begins with a plain-language explanation of separate utilities and app boundaries, then traces the corresponding implementation and its limits in question-paper-generator-from-syllabus.
learning_objectives: Explain separate utilities and app boundaries in plain language and connect it to omr_generator_app.py; generator.py; omr_pdf.py.
Trace one input through the pdf/omr companion tools stage and identify its output and assumptions.
Diagnose one failure mode or limitation before extending this stage.
prerequisites: Read project prerequisites and the previous module when present.
practical_outcomes: Trace the pdf/omr companion tools stage through the cited source paths.
Produce a small test or diagnostic for separate utilities and app boundaries.
completion_criteria: Complete the three lessons and exercise.
Answer all ten module questions using material from these lessons.
Submit a short source citation and limitation note.
